summary: The filing is a Form 6-K containing Sangoma Technologies Corp.'s unaudited interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended March 31, 2026, along with a press release announcing quarterly results. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private proposal, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, which does not qualify as a special situation.
